core_obligations: Given the separable/purely-inseparable decomposition, the standard embedding-count theorem and finiteness of roots of unity in a number field, the residual classification couples powers of x and x+1 under two different embeddings to force x into a cyclotomic constant field. The author then treats arbitrary rational translates x+y and uses a single number field containing their embedding ratios to exclude characteristic zero. This global rigidity argument supplies the complete exceptional-positive-characteristic classification; existence of individual radicals or routine minimal-polynomial arguments do not supply it. Reuse the producer detailed H2 mechanism and the full author proof,without independently certifying it.

original_difficulty_reason: 刻画「每个元素都有某次幂落回 k」的域扩张。证明自造了一个非标准论证：取 x 不在 k 与 n,m 使 x^n 与 (x+1)^m 均在 k；在代数闭包中取两个 k-嵌入 σ,τ 使 σ(x) 不等于 τ(x)，于是 σ(x)=ζτ(x)、σ(x+1)=ζ'τ(x+1)（ζ,ζ' 分别为 n 次、m 次单位根）；由 σ(x+1)=σ(x)+1 推出 τ(x)(ζ'-ζ)=1-ζ'，即 τ(x) 由单位根显式表出，故 k' 中所有不在 k 里的元素都代数于素子域；再在特征 0 时对每个有理数 y 取单位根 ζ_y，证明 ζ_y 落在固定的数域 Q(ζ,ζ') 中，从而有两个不同的 y 使 ζ_y 相同，最后算出 y-y' 等于 ζ_y(y-y') 得矛盾。难点在于用嵌入的比值把元素写成单位根的有理函数，以及特征 0 的收尾。
